title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1990-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix blend captures a strong Scarlet > Fire performance, though keyboardist Welnick’s playing feels out of step.
ai_review.review: The recording offers an excellent Matrix blend that is clear and well‑balanced, letting the band’s tight playing shine through. The show is highlighted by a great Scarlet > Fire sequence, but reviewers note Brent Welnick’s keyboards lack the usual Dead feel, tempering the overall enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: Single review gives a solid 4‑star rating, praising the sound and Scarlet > Fire while critiquing keyboard work; weighting yields an overall ~4‑star assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the Matrix blend as excellent, with no noted flaws in clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall nice show with a strong flow; the highlight is the Scarlet > Fire sequence, though keyboard performance draws criticism.

band_member_comments.Keys: Welnick’s playing described as lacking Deadness.
